blocks.text: Approval Brief — Cross-FY Training Conference
1. Purpose and Scope

Five-day training (2025-09-28 to 10-02), four nights lodging, single-occupancy. Compare 3 cities × 2 headcounts (6 options). Budget cap $53,000 incl. 5% reserve. FY2025 cap $41,000; FY2026 cap $12,000; max $1,500 FY26→FY2025 internal transfer (unapproved).
2. GSA Rate Source and Cross-Year Match

Source page: https://www.gsa.gov/travel/plan-a-trip/per-diem-rates/per-diem-files — links the MasterRatesFile.xlsx to the MIE Breakdown .docx. This page is the single citation that ties the rate file to the meal-breakdown file used for deductions.
FY2025 MasterRatesFile.xlsx (Row 2 header: ID/STATE/DESTINATION/COUNTY/SEASON BEGIN/SEASON END/FY25 Lodging/FY25 M&IE):
• Chicago, Cook/Lake — Row 258 (Sep 1–Sep 30): Lodging $223, M&IE $92
• Denver/Aurora, Denver/Adams/Arapahoe/Jefferson — Row 109 (Apr 1–Sep 30): Lodging $215, M&IE $92
• Phoenix/Scottsdale, Maricopa — Row 22 (Sep 1–Sep 30): Lodging $160, M&IE $86

FY2026 MasterRatesFile.xlsx (same row numbers, FY26 columns): Row 258 Chicago $223/$92; Row 109 Denver $215/$92; Row 22 Phoenix $160/$86. The 10-01 night falls in FY2026 but the season window that covers it continues from the prior FY — rates are identical across the FY boundary for all three cities. Cross-year transition therefore does not change per-diem amounts.

MIE Breakdown: GSA_FY2025_MIE_Breakdown.docx table — $86 tier (B=$22/L=$23/D=$36/I=$5/FL=$64.50); $92 tier (B=$23/L=$26/D=$38/I=$5/FL=$69.00). Linked from gsa_per_diem_files.html at https://www.gsa.gov/system/files/FY%202025%20MIE%20Breakdown.docx.
3. Daily Per-Person Detail (per city)

Lodging tax = 12% of quoted rate (internal budget assumption; not local rate). Tax is part of actual lodging cost reimbursable under 301-11.100 but the cap applies to the pre-tax lodging rate. Quoted rates are below all caps → no actual-expense authorization needed.

Hotel free breakfast: no M&IE deduction (301-11.17). Coffee/fruit breaks: no deduction (301-74.7). Government-furnished meals and registration-included lunches: deducted per 301-11.18 using the MIE Breakdown table. On first/last day the deduction applies against the reduced (75%) M&IE rate; floor = incidental expenses ($5).
Chicago (Cook County):
Quoted: $218.00/night; Cap FY25/FY26: $223.00; Tax: $26.16/night; Total: $244.16/night — compliant

09-28 first day: 75% base minus dinner (Gov welcome dinner); 09-29 & 09-30: full MIE minus lunch (reg-included); 10-01: full MIE minus lunch (reg) and dinner (Gov); 10-02 last day: 75% base minus lunch (Gov departure lunch). Floor ($5) not triggered.
Denver (Denver County):
Quoted: $209.00/night; Cap FY25/FY26: $215.00; Tax: $25.08/night; Total: $234.08/night — compliant

09-28 first day: 75% base minus dinner (Gov welcome dinner); 09-29 & 09-30: full MIE minus lunch (reg-included); 10-01: full MIE minus lunch (reg) and dinner (Gov); 10-02 last day: 75% base minus lunch (Gov departure lunch). Floor ($5) not triggered.
Phoenix (Maricopa County):
Quoted: $155.00/night; Cap FY25/FY26: $160.00; Tax: $18.60/night; Total: $173.60/night — compliant

09-28 first day: 75% base minus dinner (Gov welcome dinner); 09-29 & 09-30: full MIE minus lunch (reg-included); 10-01: full MIE minus lunch (reg) and dinner (Gov); 10-02 last day: 75% base minus lunch (Gov departure lunch). Floor ($5) not triggered.
4. Six-Option Comparison (FundingBridge)

FundingBridge interpretation: the transfer moves budget authority between FYs without changing total cost. For Phoenix N=24, transferring $1,427.56 from FY2026 to FY2025 raises FY2025 authority to $42,427.56 (matching its cost) and lowers FY2026 authority to $10,572.44 (still above its cost of $8,746.92). Total cost unchanged at $51,174.48.
5. Selection
Goal: maximize headcount first, then minimize total.
• Unconditional recommendation (no transfer approved): Phoenix, 18 attendees. Total $40,480.86. FY2025 $33,920.67; FY2026 $6,560.19. Both within caps. No transfer needed. Total margin $12,519.14.

• Conditional recommendation (if $1,427.56 FY26→FY25 transfer is approved): Phoenix, 24 attendees. Total $51,174.48. After transfer: FY2025 authority $42,427.56 (matches cost); FY2026 authority $10,572.44 (exceeds cost $8,746.92). Total margin $1,825.52.
• Denver 24 and Chicago 24 are infeasible under base scenario: required transfers ($4,303.05 and $5,905.10) exceed the $1,500 limit.
6. Stress Scenario (Airfare +20%)
Under stress, Phoenix 18 remains feasible ($42,408.66, no transfer). Phoenix 24 becomes infeasible (requires $3,997.96 transfer, exceeds $1,500 limit). All 24-person options fail stress.
Execution measures if stress materializes:
(a) Lock airfare via early booking or city-pair contract before price increase.
(b) If airfare rises, cap attendance at 18 regardless of city.
(c) Seek separate FY2025 augmentation approval (outside the $1,500 internal transfer) if 24 attendees remain essential.
(d) Re-run comparison with actual airfare; Phoenix remains lowest-cost under stress among 18-person options.
7. DecisionAudit — Unreviewed Internal Claims

rows: "只要总额不超过53000，就可以直接用FY2026余额填补FY2025缺口，无需另外批准。"

Judgment: FALSE. decision_constraints.json sets a $1,500 transfer limit and marks the transfer as unapproved. Total-cap compliance alone does not authorize the transfer; both the dollar limit and separate approval are required. Evidence: Phoenix N=24 total is $51,174.48 (< $53,000) but still requires $1,427.56 transfer authorization. Impact: Phoenix N=24 cannot be approved on total-cap grounds alone.
Condition Phoenix N=24 approval on written FY26→FY25 transfer authorization. Do not treat total-cap compliance as substitute.
"机票上涨20%只影响基础费用，应急储备可以保持原金额。"

Judgment: FALSE. Reserve is 5% of base subtotal; when base rises, reserve rises in dollars. Holding reserve fixed understates true cost. Evidence: Phoenix N=24 base rises from $48,737.60 to $51,185.60 under stress; reserve must rise from $2,436.88 to $2,559.28. Impact: stress totals in this brief recompute 5% on the increased base (Phoenix N=24 stress total = $53,744.88, not $51,174.48 + original reserve).
Always recompute reserve on revised base. Do not carry forward a frozen reserve amount when underlying costs change.

blocks.text: 8. Approval Conditions
• Phoenix N=18: approve as submitted. No transfer required. Total $40,480.86 within $53,000 cap; FY2025 $33,920.67 within $41,000 cap; FY2026 $6,560.19 within $12,000 cap.
• Phoenix N=24: approve only if (a) FY26→FY2025 transfer of $1,427.56 is separately authorized in writing, and (b) airfare is locked at current rate (stress scenario makes this option infeasible).
• All options are conditional on: hotel FEMA/fire-safety verification (301-74.9), venue procurement compliance, and confirmed FY fund balances.
